results.title: Middle Life
results.overview: Andie saves Ryan from a car wreck, sparking a tumultuous year that might just prove life could be great.

results.title: Offshoring
results.overview: The day Redouane is going to get his promotion and finally become a foreman, he learns that the mattress factory where he works is being relocated to India. Determined to keep his promotion, he agrees to leave while having the guarantee of being paid double and takes his partner Marguerite with him. Once there, he discovers that his boss has duped him, he will indeed be paid double but in rupees. Furious, he decides to take revenge by teaching the teams the best of French social rights: strikes, demonstrations and RTT with the sole aim of overthrowing his boss. Between culture clash and social struggle, Redouane leads an unexpected revolution that could well change the destiny of the factory... and his own.

results.title: The Red Mask
results.overview: Queer screenwriter Allina Green is hired to write the final Red Mask slasher. Under pressure and facing death threats, she and her fiancé retreat to a secluded Airbnb. A twisted game spirals into a deadly fight when uninvited guests crash.

results.title: Warlord
results.overview: Revolt is on the horizon in the ancient city of Lloris, ruled with an iron fist by the merciless Sheriff and The Brute. Believing their mystical powers could help free the oppressed citizens from tyranny, a young human seeks out the aid of the reclusive elves and their legendary Warlord. However, with both sides harbouring secrets, and hiding their true motives, this tentative alliance between the humans and elves may bring about the downfall of them all.

results.title: Trapped in Her Dorm Room
results.overview: When a classmate's adoration turns into a dangerous obsession, college student Erin finds herself held captive in her own dorm room during spring break.

results.title: Xtreme
results.overview: Her Clothes! Her Right!  a Feminism is Talking About the Heroine Who Wears Clothes in an Exceedingly Attractive Style! What Happened to a Girl Who Wanted to Be Like Her, What Happened to That Girl's Condition, When the Police Find Out Who is Responsible for Her Condition, They Find That She Has Been Brutally Murdered. How Do the Police Find the Killer Responsible for the Murder by Intensive Investigation! This Story.

results.title: Shiver Me Timbers
results.overview: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema- obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

results.title: The Dollhouse
results.overview: The Dollhouse is an unfolding paper world where 9-year-old Juniper begins to untangle feelings of guilt about how her family treated Magnolia, a woman who came from far away to work as a cleaner in their house. This animated interactive VR tale explores how power dynamics are born within the intimacy of our homes. While reenacting memories with her dolls, Juniper becomes ashamed of her actions and finds the courage to stand up to her parents and follow her heart. Will you help her ask for forgiveness?

results.title: Love, Z
results.overview: Love, Z is a generational portrait and a middle finger to patriarchal supremacy disguised as a love letter. Twelve Gen Z voices question how capitalism, technology, and patriarchy shape modern love. Among them, Amalie and Sonia invite us into their private lives, searching for three kinds of love: for themselves, for others, and for life itself.

results.title: The Stringer: The Man Who Took the Photo
results.original_title: The Stringer: The Man Who Took the Photo
results.overview: A two-year investigation uncovers a scandal behind the making of one of the most recognized photographs of the 20th century. Five decades of secrets are unraveled in the search for justice for a man known only as  "the stringer."

results.title: Butcher's Stain
results.overview: The story follows Samir, a Palestinian butcher falsely accused by his manager of removing hostage posters, forcing him to fight for his job and innocence amidst rising prejudice.

results.title: Mushroom Dad
results.overview: A young chef must take care of his Chinese-immigrant father who accidentally consumes psychedelic mushrooms on the opening night of his restaurant.

results.title: Keluarga Besar
results.overview: Pak Wahyu, who only worked as an electronic equipment repairman in a rented shop, was made dizzy by his wife and two children who are only busy with their own lives. There are rumors that Mrs. Wiwik is a fraud, Agung is a believer in black magic, and Ati is pregnant out of wedlock increasingly widespread in their flats. Pak Wahyu also tried to create a large family they were whole again and loved each other.

results.title: Kontrabida
results.overview: Once feared on screen for their chilling portrayals of criminals and villains, retired actors get one last shot to prove they're more than just tough guys—they're the heroes no one saw coming.

results.title: The One Who Waits Below
results.overview: A Florida scavenger named Dewey Shawn accepts a strange barter from a button-obsessed recluse, leading him to a deserted drive-in where a final exchange with the "one who waits below" threatens to cost him more than he bargained for.

results.title: Keeping Company
results.overview: A diary.exe of her pixelf- isolation echoes through Robbie's webcam.

results.title: Close Encounter
results.overview: A skeptical teenage girl, Riley, reluctantly joins her UFO-obsessed father, Jerry, on a road trip to a UFO convention, only to experience an otherworldly encounter that brings them closer together.

results.title: Flowers for Antonio
results.overview: A daughter sets out to find out the truth about the man who was her father, a legendary musician, who died when she was 8 years old. He is Antonio Flores, and she the also famous actress Alba Flores. Alba stopped singing when she lost Antonio and is now determined to recover her voice and her background, asking family members and friends for the first time.

results.title: Fear Anonymous
results.overview: Jack Miller operates a self help group that focuses on fear and trauma. This story takes place in one of his meetings he holds at the community center. Everyone in the group has a different story about why they have fear in their lives. Rick seems to stumble upon this group of different people and decides to sit in. The stories range from domestic infidelity, paranormal activity, witches, cannibalism and even rape. None of the stories come close to what Rick brings with him. This is a anthology that will keep you on your feet.
